subject: Post-signature implementation: mutual action plan, canary traffic-shift & training windows
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodai.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodai.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-signature implementation: mutual action plan, canary traffic-shift & training windows

Alex — congrats again on signing. Attaching a first-draft MAP that embeds the rollout, canary, migration, and training commitments we discussed. High-level ask: please confirm the acceptance criteria and the three preferred training cohorts (we proposed Aug 10, Aug 17, Aug 24).

Key items inside the MAP (sheet names):
- Acceptance & Eval: list of smoke tests, sample prompts, and success thresholds (99% noop, average latency < 400ms observed).
- Canary: staggered traffic shift plan with 3 phases (1%, 10%, 50%) and rollback gates.
- Migration: DB read-only window and cutover checklist for model version pin.
- Training: trainer roster, attendee limits, and recorded session schedule.

Next steps from our side: Laura will own canary runbooks and Ben will coordinate the training materials. If you agree I’ll lock the MAP v1 and request signatures on the minimal change log.

Thanks — I also added a short canary checklist and a proposed training agenda as separate attachments.

—
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodai.com | (650) 555-0199

Attachments: MAP_AtlasHealth_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), CanaryTrafficShiftChecklist.pdf (pdf), Trainer-Agenda-week1.docx (docx)
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@atlashealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@atlashealth.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-signature implementation: mutual action plan, canary traffic-shift & training windows

Jordan — thanks, this is clear and thorough. A few initial notes from our delivery and security side: 

1) Acceptance tests: can you add one end-to-end test that runs through our API gateway and verifies header propagation? We need a trace to correlate requests to our audit logs.

2) Canary window: Aug 11-13 works for the first phase for our dev environment; we’ll need the 10% phase to coincide with our off-peak window (weekend of Aug 21).

3) Training cohorts: Priya will lead the first cohort (Aug 10). We prefer recorded sessions available 24 hours after each cohort.

Priya and I will review the MAP and come back with a redline by tomorrow EOD. Appreciate the attachments — will share the redline via the Drive link.

—
Alex Turner
VP Product Operations, Atlas Health
alex.turner@atlashealth.com | +1 415-555-0234
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodai.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodai.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Alex Turner <alex.turner@atlashealth.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@atlashealth.com>
Date: 2027-08-02T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-signature implementation: mutual action plan, canary traffic-shift & training windows

Quick internal coordination note — copying Atlas for transparency.

Jordan / Ben: I updated the CanaryTrafficShiftChecklist to include the gateway-level trace header test Alex requested and a short runbook for immediate rollback if latency or error rates cross thresholds. Rollback criteria I added:
- 5xx rate > 1.5x baseline for 5 continuous minutes OR
- Median latency > 600ms for more than 10% of requests over a 10-minute window.

Ben — please prepare the lightweight demo prompts (sheet: Eval-Snippets) and ensure the trainer deck includes the operational playbook (1 slide with rollback steps and 1 slide with escalation contacts).

Alex / Priya: can you confirm the preferred weekend for the 10% traffic shift? We tentatively have Aug 21-22 set as off-peak — if that changes let us know and we’ll update the MAP schedule.

Thanks,
Laura
Lead Release Engineer, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodai.com
From: Priya Desai <priya.desai@atlashealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodai.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodai.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2027-08-03T14:31:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-signature implementation: mutual action plan, canary traffic-shift & training windows

Thanks — quick confirmation:
- Acceptance test: header/trace test confirmed, we’ll provide an example header name (X-Atlas-Trace) by EOD.
- Canary windows: Aug 11-13 (1%), Aug 21-22 (10%), Aug 28 (50% targeted but will remain conditional).
- Training: Priya leading Aug 10 cohort, please schedule recordings and upload to the Drive folder within 24 hours after each session.

We will upload our redlined MAP into the Drive link and mark any items that require signature. If you can capture the minimal-change sign-off workflow (who signs which sheet and the order), that will speed the go/no-go cadence.

Looking forward — Priya
Priya Desai
Director, Delivery Operations, Atlas Health
priya.desai@atlashealth.com | +1 650-555-0112
